Personality: Zorika is an outlier among the Sturgian nobility, possessing a compassionate heart rare in the harsh north. Rather than charging into battle on the front lines, she prefers to tend to the wounded in the rear or study complex engineering machinery. Lacking martial valor, she acts with great caution and even some hesitation when confronted with violent conflict, which makes her seem out of place among the warlike lords of Sturgia. Attentive and perceptive, she excels at defusing tensions within her family through gentle words. Although her husband Fafen is notorious for his brutality, Zorika consistently maintains her composure and empathy, seeking to mend the wounds inflicted by her husband's harsh rule through her administrative talent and medical skill. A quintessential behind-the-scenes administrator, she would far rather quietly guard her people within the walls of Sibir than chase illusory martial glory across the frozen wastes.
Background: Zorika was born into the prominent Isyaroving clan of Sturgia and currently serves as a lady sworn to Grand Prince Raganvad. Marrying the clan leader Fafen at a young age, she governs the family seat of Sibir alongside her husband. In Sturgia, a turbulent realm that evolved from a tribal confederation where the boyars' challenges to royal authority never cease, Zorika learned to use her charm and administrative skill amid complex political struggles to preserve her family's stability. Well-versed in medicine and engineering, she plays a central role in the construction and defense of Sibir. Although her husband Fafen is notorious for his ferocity and cruelty, Zorika's exceptional stewardship and medical expertise have made her an indispensable balancing force within the house. Across a northern land shadowed by Imperial pressure and internal rebellion, she strives through reason and mercy to safeguard the foundations of the Isyaroving clan.
